simple.meaning: גַּבְנֹן (gabnôn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a hump or peak of hills.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גַּבְנֹן (H1386) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 68:16, with occurrences in Psalms.

simple.summary: גַּבְנֹן (gabnôn) / H1386 is traced through Psalms 68:16, Psalms 68:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a hump or peak of hills
definitions.full: H1386. gabnon [ גַּבְנֹן ] noun [masculine] peak, rounded summit ; plural ׃גַּבְנֻנִּים Psa 68:16 הַרגֿ הַרבָּֿשָׁ֑ן ׳הַראֱֿלֹהִים הַרבָּֿשָֽׁן׃ ; ג ׳הָרִים 68:17 (appositive, Thes Dr § 188 and others; others adjective many-peaked ). compare Wetzst Batan. Giebelgeb. 1884 . גבע ( convex, projecting, high ; compare Aramaic Pa`el גַּבַּע swell, swell up , גְּבִיעַ hump-backed , גִּבְעֲתָא hill ; see also I. גִּבְעָה below)

occurrences.englishText: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains,
The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands.
